datasets.attribution: Forex Exchange Rates Since 2004 by asaniczka (Kaggle)
datasets.transformations: kept USD, GBP, INR, JPY vs EUR base for business days 2025-12-31..2026-06-30 (project calendar); converted to USD per 1 unit: EUR = USD/EUR; X = (USD/EUR)/(X/EUR); exact Decimal division, 8 dp ROUND_HALF_EVEN
datasets.fields_discarded: currency_name; all other 172 currencies; weekend/holiday rows; dates outside the window

datasets.attribution: Accounts Receivable & Payment Delay Analysis by Sonali Singh (Kaggle)
datasets.transformations: customers with >=20 invoices segmented by median delay (A <=2d, B 3-10d, C >10d); per segment: trim 1%/99% tails, shift = floor(p05), method-of-moments gamma on (delay - shift)
datasets.fields_discarded: all other 27 columns (amounts, regions, cities, zip codes, dates, payment methods, flags)
datasets.note: only aggregate statistics are stored; no rows are redistributed
